entities.summary: Iosipos Moisiodax or Moesiodax was a Greek and later Wallachian philosopher, an Eastern Orthodox deacon, and one of the greatest exponents of the modern Greek Enlightenment. He was also director of the Princely Academy of Iași and professor at the Princely Academy of Bucharest.
